name: QSTN-2026-00001
question_text: Full legal name of the company / organisation as registered
help_text: Provide the exact name as it appears on your Certificate of Registration.

name: QSTN-2026-00002
question_text: Year the company was established / incorporated
help_text: Provide the 4-digit year, e.g. 2010.

name: QSTN-2026-00003
question_text: Total number of full-time employees currently on payroll
help_text: Include permanent staff only, not casuals or contractors.
scoring_rubric: {"type": "numeric_range", "ranges": [{"min": 100, "max": null, "label": "100+ employees", "points": 10}, {"min": 50, "max": 99, "label": "50-99 employees", "points": 8}, {"min": 20, "max": 49, "label": "20-49 employees", "points": 6}, {"min": 10, "max": 19, "label": "10-19 employees", "points": 4}, {"min": 1, "max": 9, "label": "1-9 employees", "points": 2}]}

name: QSTN-2026-00004
question_text: Primary business category that best describes your core activity
help_text: Select the one category that represents 50%+ of your revenue.
dropdown_options:
Goods & Supplies
Services
Civil Works
Consultancy

Pharmaceuticals

name: QSTN-2026-00005
question_text: Certification(s) or quality standards held by your organisation
help_text: Select all that apply. Supporting documents will be requested.
multi_select_options:
ISO 9001 (Quality Management)

name: QSTN-2026-00006
question_text: Certificate of Registration / Incorporation
help_text: Upload a legible scanned copy. PDF or image formats accepted (max 5 MB).

name: QSTN-2026-00007
question_text: Tax Compliance Certificate (TCC) from KRA
help_text: Must be currently valid. Expired certificates will result in a non-compliant flag.

name: QSTN-2026-00008
question_text: Is your Tax Compliance Certificate currently valid (not expired)?
help_text: Select Yes only if the TCC expiry date is after today.

name: QSTN-2026-00009
question_text: Expiry date of your Tax Compliance Certificate
help_text: Enter the date printed on the TCC from KRA iTax.

name: QSTN-2026-00010
question_text: KRA PIN Certificate
help_text: Upload a copy of your organisation's KRA PIN Certificate.

name: QSTN-2026-00011
question_text: Annual turnover for the most recent completed financial year (KES)
help_text: Enter the total revenue figure from your audited accounts. Do not include VAT.

name: QSTN-2026-00012
question_text: Annual turnover for the previous financial year (KES)
help_text: Enter the revenue figure from the year before last. Must be supported by audited accounts.

name: QSTN-2026-00013
question_text: Audited Financial Statements (most recent year)
help_text: Upload audited P&L and balance sheet. Signed by a registered CPA(K).

name: QSTN-2026-00014
question_text: Does your company have a documented Occupational Health & Safety (OHS) Policy?
help_text: A policy signed by senior management and communicated to all staff.

name: QSTN-2026-00015
question_text: Upload your OHS Policy document
help_text: Required only if you answered Yes to the previous question.

name: QSTN-2026-00016
question_text: Does your company have an Anti-Corruption / Code of Conduct Policy?
help_text: A formal written policy prohibiting bribery, corruption, and related misconduct.

name: QSTN-2026-00017
question_text: Trade Reference 1: Organisation name, contact person, phone, and nature of work supplied
help_text: Must be an organisation you have supplied goods or services to in the last 3 years. Provide full contact details.

name: QSTN-2026-00018
question_text: Trade Reference 2: Organisation name, contact person, phone, and nature of work supplied
help_text: Must be a different organisation from Reference 1. NGO/public sector references preferred.

name: QSTN-2026-00019
question_text: Trade Reference 3 (optional): Organisation name, contact person, phone, and nature of work supplied
help_text: Providing a third reference strengthens your application.

name: QSTN-2026-00020
question_text: Has your company ever been debarred, suspended, or blacklisted from any public procurement process?
help_text: Answer honestly. A Yes answer will trigger a mandatory compliance review but does not automatically disqualify you.

name: QSTN-2026-00021
question_text: I, the undersigned authorised representative, declare that all information provided in this prequalification application is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any misrepresentation may result in disqualification and/or removal from the KRCS supplier register.
help_text: Tick to confirm acceptance of the declaration. By submitting this form you are electronically signing this declaration.
